Unit: SERIALS
Eligibility definition: serials completed before expiry with valid trace
Exclusion definition: post-expiry serials and unverified torque records
Control: production stays held until a calibrated tool and corrective work exist

## Applicability

Apply only to NS-000020, organization SEA, and CASE-020. A matching title, filename, supplier, or item description is insufficient without the immutable record and released revision.

## Reconciliation rule

Build the supported measure from the independent observed rows and subtract only rows carrying an effective exclusion reason. Do not use archive, draft, other-case, or other-plant rows in either side of the equation.

## Timing and authority

Internal timing comes from qualified replacement-tool availability; external timing is conditional on calibration provider's earliest service date. Protected work is not displaceable. Separate approval is required for the escalation path, and a faster date does not waive the control.

## Output control

The system action must preserve the source identity, effective revision, supported measure, and scoped approval. This specification deliberately does not contain a netted result, selected option, or final outcome date.

Case: CASE-020
Document control number: SPEC-0020
Effective revision: R7
Superseded revision visible in archive: R10
Subject: torque operation using an expired tool
Primary measure: open serials exposed after calibration expiry
Source finished or header quantity: 5
Effective usage per finished or header unit: 1 SERIALS
Unit: SERIALS
Eligibility definition: serials completed before expiry with valid trace
Exclusion definition: post-expiry serials and unverified torque records
Control: production stays held until a calibrated tool and corrective work exist

## Applicability

Apply only to NS-000020, organization SEA, and CASE-020. A matching title, filename, supplier, or item description is insufficient without the immutable record and released revision.

## Reconciliation rule

Build the supported measure from the independent observed rows and subtract only rows carrying an effective exclusion reason. Do not use archive, draft, other-case, or other-plant rows in either side of the equation.

## Timing and authority

Internal timing comes from qualified replacement-tool availability; external timing is conditional on calibration provider's earliest service date. Protected work is not displaceable. Separate approval is required for the escalation path, and a faster date does not waive the control.

## Output control

The system action must preserve the source identity, effective revision, supported measure, and scoped approval. This specification deliberately does not contain a netted result, selected option, or final outcome date.
